high_level_description: The image is an advertisement for a luxury watch ring called the "Sofia Prism Cocktail Watch Ring" by Pascal. The background of the image is predominantly green, which complements the green face of the watch. In the left section of the image, there is a close-up of a person's hand wearing the watch ring on their ring finger. The person is dressed in a bright green sweater and black pants, which further accentuates the green color of the watch. The hand is positioned with the palm facing slightly downward, and the wrist is adorned with a beaded bracelet.
